trap-nonspeakable.notes: RECOMPUTED EVERY NUMERIC IN THIS BLOCK. Three independent recomputations give 3.84e6: the secant from the block's own two anchor c_3 values = 3.83746e6; 2.37 x (1/u^3) with the canonical u = 0.00852 = 3.83204e6; and the witness's own data/hypersensitivity_decomp/S_prime_qstar = 3838404.458 with inv_u_cubed = 1618467.41 (ratio 2.3717 = the quoted prefactor). 4.7e6 would require u = 0.0079595. PROPOSED: '$dc_3/dq \approx 3.84\times10^{6}$'. (2) '$\approx 367\times$ more precise' is 22 ppb / 0.06 ppb = 366.67, the SUPERSEDED proton precision; the live figure is 0.017 ppb, giving 1294x, and the companion '$\approx 0.0007\%$ muon-ward' recomputes to 0.000744% at 0.06 ppb but 0.00006% at 0.017 ppb. Pin-currency only — the argument strengthens under the tighter value. Witness carries the same stale 366.7.
